name: online-course-notes-11ty
description: a skeleton project using 11ty to generate course notes

scripts.clean: node -e "import('fs').then(fs => fs.rmSync('public', { recursive: true, force: true }))"
scripts.reinstall: node -e "import('fs').then(fs => fs.rmSync('node_modules', { recursive: true, force: true }))" && npm cache verify && npm install
